item.title: Disclaimer
item.description:
All product loads, dimensions, weights and configurations shown on this website are preliminary reference information. Performance depends on the selected mold, material grade, steel reinforcement, temperature, load distribution, support span, dwell time and test method.

Do not select a pallet for an AS/RS solely from website values. The final approved technical data sheet, drawing, sample validation and commercial agreement take precedence.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Storack collects the contact and project information you submit so we can respond to inquiries, prepare quotations and provide technical support. We do not sell personal information. Information may be processed by service providers that support website hosting, security and inquiry management, subject to appropriate safeguards.

You may request access, correction or deletion of your submitted information by emailing sales@storack.com. We retain inquiry records only as long as reasonably necessary for business, legal and security purposes.
